name: Side B Coffee — Roastery & Listening Bar
description: A warm, cream-and-rust site for Side B, a small-batch roaster that pours its coffee in two record bars: a condensed-serif voice on a golden-ratio scale with tight tracking, mono-caps printed-label buttons and soft warm shadows. A hero reel cutting between the roaster and a spinning record, a manifesto that inks itself in as you read, a shelf of SVG coffee bags whose labels come from the data, cards that flood rust on hover, a pinned five-track walk from cherry to cup, a turntable and footer player that genuinely play (synthesised in the browser), a merch shelf, a community board that opens into posts and RSVPs, a wholesale enquiry form and live open/closed hours — plus Shop, Subscribe and Our story pages and a live brand guide.
designedFor: Coffee roasters, cafés, bakeries and record or listening bars
Independent food and drink brands selling online and in person
Story-led shop pages with sticky, scroll-scrubbed sections and working product mockups
Seeing SVG product mockups, a working cart and a playable audio player built as editor-controllable components
